n: 9+ NAD+ Peptides Dewy Sun Essence SPF50+ PA++++
ex: A dewy sun essence that treats as it shields.
d: Sunscreen is the step most routines skip because of how it feels. This one is an essence first: thin, dewy, and gone in seconds.
NAD+ and peptides sit underneath the filters, so the step is doing something for firmness as well as protection.

n: Zero-Cast Moisturizing Finish Sunscreen SPF50 PA++++
ex: No white cast, on any skin tone.
d: Zero-cast is the whole claim, and it is the one that matters most here: a sunscreen that disappears rather than sitting grey on deeper skin.
The finish is moisturising rather than matte, so it suits skin that finds most sunscreens drying.

n: Seoul 1988 Sun: Collagen Complex 7 + Plum
ex: Daily sun protection with collagen worked in.
d: The sun step of the Seoul 1988 line, built on the same collagen complex as the rest of the range.
Plum extract keeps the texture light enough to wear under makeup.

n: Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++
ex: Aloe in the base, for skin that burns and reacts.
d: Aloe has calmed sun-exposed skin for as long as anyone has grown it, and COSRX build the whole formula around it rather than adding a token amount.
A soothing cream texture, which suits skin already irritated before the sunscreen goes on.

n: Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: 54.2% aloe water, with a light tone-up finish.
d: Aloe leaf water replaces most of the water in the formula, which is where the 54.2% comes from.
The tone-up is subtle - skin reads brighter rather than paler, and it sits well under makeup.

n: Complete No-Stress Physical Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: A mineral sunscreen with mugwort and niacinamide behind it.
d: Physical filters suit skin that reacts to chemical ones, and the usual cost is a heavy, chalky finish. The advanced formula is AXIS-Y's answer to that.
Mugwort calms, niacinamide works on tone, squalane keeps it comfortable through the day.

n: Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The brightening sunscreen in the centella range.
d: Tone work and sun protection in the same step, with centella keeping the whole thing calm enough for daily use.
A light tone-up finish rather than a mask - it evens out rather than covers.

n: Collagen Glow Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: No cast, just glow - the line on the tube, and it holds.
d: Medicube's collagen range extended into sun care, with the same bouncy finish the jelly cream is known for.
Dewy rather than matte, so it suits dry skin and photographs well.

n: Glutathione Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: Sun protection and the brightening pair in one tube.
d: Pigment comes back without daily sunscreen, which is why APLB put their glutathione and niacinamide into the sun step itself.
A light lotion texture that layers over a serum without pilling.

n: PDRN Pink Tone Up Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The PDRN line's sun step, with a soft tone-up.
d: PDRN is the repair ingredient the rest of the pink range is built on, carried here into the step that prevents the damage in the first place.
The tone-up is gentle; it warms the skin rather than whitening it.

n: Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Glow Sun Ampoule SPF50+ PA++++
ex: An ampoule-textured sunscreen with probiotic centella.
d: Thin enough to feel like a serum, which is the reason people actually reapply it.
The probiotic centella base suits skin that is unsettled as well as exposed.

n: Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: Water resistant, very high protection, and still soft on the skin.
d: Purito build for reactive skin, and this is the sunscreen version of that: very high protection without the sting most high-SPF formulas bring.
Water resistant, and a larger 60 ml tube, which matters for a product that should be used generously.

n: Madagascar Centella Poremizing Velvet Finish Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: A velvet, blurring finish for oily skin.
d: The poremizing line is built for skin that shines by midday, and this is its sun step: velvet rather than dewy.
It blurs the look of pores as it goes on, which is why it works under makeup.

n: Zero Pore Moisture Sun Serum SPF50+ PA++++
ex: A sun serum from the pore line, with ten hyaluronic acids.
d: Serum-textured sun care for skin that wants protection without another layer of cream.
Ten molecular weights of hyaluronic acid keep it hydrating rather than drying, which is unusual at this finish.

n: Hyaluronic Acid Watery Sun Gel SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The watery sun gel people rebuy in threes.
d: A gel that behaves like water: no cast, no tack, and nothing left sitting on the skin.
High protection in a texture that survives humidity, which is the hard part in Kampala.

n: Heartleaf Silky Moisture Sun Cream SPF50+ PA++++
ex: Heartleaf and panthenol, in the calmest sunscreen Anua make.
d: The heartleaf line exists for skin that flushes and reacts, and this carries it into the step that often sets that skin off.
Silky rather than greasy, and it layers under makeup without rolling.

n: Face & Body Sun Block SPF50+ PA+++
ex: Broad-spectrum protection for face and body, with no white cast.
d: A lightweight formula meant to be used generously, on the face and everywhere else the sun reaches.
Made for all skin types, and specifically formulated to leave no white cast.

n: Green Tea Fresh Sunscreen SPF50 PA+++
ex: Green tea and centella, in a fresh daily sunscreen.
d: Green tea water instead of plain water, with centella and madecassoside doing the calming.
Fresh and light, built for skin that gets oily and still needs daily protection.

n: Aqua Glowing Sunscreen SPF50 PA++++
ex: A glowing, hydrating sunscreen with ceramides in it.
d: Ceramides in a sunscreen are rare, and they are the reason this one does not leave dry skin tight by the afternoon.
The finish is aqua-glow: hydrated and lit, not shiny.

n: Relief Sun: Rice + Probiotics SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The sunscreen that made Beauty of Joseon a household name.
d: Rice and probiotics in a sunscreen so light that people forget they are wearing one, which is exactly why it gets reapplied.
Brightens gently over time, on top of the protection.

n: Relief Sun: Aqua Fresh Rice + B5 SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The fresher, lighter sibling of the original Relief Sun.
d: Same rice base, rebuilt around panthenol and a watery finish for skin that found the original too dewy.
The one to reach for in heat and humidity.

n: Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Water-Fit Sun Serum SPF50+ PA++++
ex: The blue line's sun serum: water-light, no cast.
d: SKIN1004's most reordered sunscreen, and the one usually recommended to people who say they hate sunscreen.
Hyaluronic acid and centella, in a serum texture that vanishes.

n: Black Rice Moisture Airyfit Daily Sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++
ex: Fermented black rice, with a non-greasy velvet finish.
d: Haruharu Wonder leave out alcohol and fragrance across the range, and the sunscreen is no exception.
Airy going on, velvet once it sets, and comfortable on skin that reacts to most SPF.

n: Kojic Acid Turmeric Toning Cleanser
ex: The first step of the kojic acid routine.
d: A cleanser that starts the brightening rather than washing it off, with kojic acid and turmeric in the lather.
Rinses clean without the squeak that means a stripped barrier.

n: Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Cleansing Gel Foam
ex: A gel foam that brightens while it cleans.
d: Gel to foam on contact, with centella keeping it gentle enough for twice a day.
The brightening member of the SKIN1004 cleansing family.

n: Calendula Rice Mochi Cleanser
ex: A mochi-textured cleanser with calendula, for sore skin.
d: Arencia make their cleansers by hand in a texture closer to a dessert than a cosmetic, and it is not a gimmick: the mochi melts rather than drags.
Calendula is the traditional answer to inflamed skin, which is what this one is for.

n: Fresh Green Rice Mochi Cleanser
ex: The green one, for skin that gets oily and congested.
d: Same mochi texture as the calendula version, rebuilt for skin that needs a deeper clean.
Hydrating and deep cleansing at once, which is a harder balance than it sounds.

n: Heartleaf Quercetinol Pore Deep Cleansing Foam
ex: Heartleaf and BHA, aimed deep into the pore.
d: The cleansing step of Anua's pore line, with quercetinol doing the calming that acids usually cost you.
Thorough without stripping, which is why it suits daily use on oily skin.

n: Triple PDRN Gel Toner 6:1:1 Advanced Formula
ex: Three sources of PDRN, in a gel toner.
d: PDRN is the repair ingredient Korean clinics use after procedures, and AXIS-Y have built a whole toner around three forms of it.
A gel rather than a liquid, so it layers without running off the hands.

n: Kojic Acid Turmeric Pad
ex: Seventy pads of the kojic acid routine, in one wipe.
d: The pad version of Medicube's dark spot line: exfoliation and pigment work in a single step.
Textured on one side, smooth on the other, so you choose how much lift you want.
Seventy pads, which is roughly a two-month course.
caution: Start every other night and wear sunscreen daily.

n: Ultimate Glow Brightening Toner
ex: Kojic and glycolic acid, with niacinamide behind them.
d: A brightening and exfoliating toner in one bottle, built for skin holding onto dark marks.
Hyaluronic acid keeps the acids from leaving skin tight.
A generous 300 ml, for daily use with a cotton pad.
caution: Contains glycolic acid. Introduce slowly and wear sunscreen every day.

n: Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Daily Mask
ex: Daily pads for blemishes and the marks they leave.
d: Hypoallergenic daily pads with niacinamide, built for skin that breaks out and then keeps the mark for months.
Yuja and arbutin work on the tone while the niacinamide handles the blemish.

n: Madagascar Centella Poremizing Clear Toner
ex: The pore toner of the centella range.
d: Gentle PHA keeps the pore clear while centella keeps the skin calm, which is the balance oily skin usually has to choose between.
A clear liquid that absorbs instantly, with no residue to layer over.
